schema_description: Resolved metadata sidecar for tile_size_comparison.json in paper-tables.
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. This is a presentation aggregate; the underlying statistical test is the McNemar + permutation procedure in scripts/compare_tile_sizes.py.

statistical_methodology.primary_test: McNemar + paired permutation test (n_permutations=10000, seed=42), tile-level (paired symbol match)
statistical_methodology.bootstrap_CIs_source: Point estimates with CIs (where reported) inherit from results/pairwise/tile-size-30m/**/evaluation.json (inferable; tile-level n=1000, seed=42) and from results/pairwise/tile-size-mcnemar-30m/tile_size_comparison.json (YES; seed=42).

notes: Paper-table view of the 30 m tile-size comparison. Primary statistics come from the McNemar + permutation file (explicit metadata).
